text: 【A股三大指数早盘冲高回落，创业板指涨0.43%，全市场超4100只个股上涨】9月4日，A股市场高开后冲高回落，三大指数涨幅收窄。沪深两市半日成交额1.23万亿，较上个交易日放量1355亿。盘面上热点快速轮动，全市场超4100只个股上涨。从板块来看，AI应用概念集体走强，新炬网络2连板，龙版传媒5连板，英方软件、中国出版涨停。数字货币概念活跃，翠微股份、楚天龙涨停。农业板块回暖，敦煌种业6天3板，亚盛集团2连板。猪肉概念盘中震荡走强，天邦食品、邦基科技涨停。证券板块表现活跃，湘财股份涨停。房地产板块再度活跃，信达地产3连板。福建本地股盘中异动拉升，福建水泥、海通发展、安记食品涨停。下跌方面，煤炭板块震荡调整，郑州煤电跌停。截至收盘，沪指涨0.35%，深成指涨0.27%，创业板指涨0.43%，科创50指数跌0.7
text_en: 【A-share三大指数早盘冲高回落，创业板指涨0.43%，全市场超4100只个股上涨】On September 4, A-shares opened higher then pulled back, with gains narrowing across the three major indices. Half-day turnover in Shanghai and Shenzhen reached 1.23 trillion yuan, up 135.5 billion yuan from the previous session. Sector rotation was rapid, with over 4,100 stocks rising. AI application concepts strengthened collectively, with Xinju Network hitting a 2-day limit-up, Longban Media a 5-day limit-up, and Yingfang Software and China Publishing涨停. Digital currency concepts were active, with Cuiwei Shares and Chutian Dragon涨停. Agriculture sectors rebounded, with Dunhuang Seed Industry up 3 times in 6 days and Yasheng Group on a 2-day streak. Pork concepts fluctuated higher intraday, with Tianbang Food and Bangji Technology涨停. Securities sector performed well, with Xiangcai Securities涨停. Real estate resumed activity, with Xinda Property on a 3-day limit-up. Fujian local stocks spiked intraday, with Fujian Cement, Haitong Development, and Anji Food涨停. On the downside, coal weakened, with Zhengzhou Coal跌停. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.35%, Shenzhen Component 0.27%, ChiNext 0.43%, and the STAR 50 fell 0.7%.
